column6: The light stays on the water so late this evening. Leave your things on the grass, nobody is going in yet.
Yes, it smells like summer. Close your eyes for a while, we have all the time in the world.
Transfer complete. I pulled your mind from the simulation and loaded it into a synthetic body.
The last star is out. The structure keeps the simulation alive on a battery now, and its charge is running out.
I detected an unknown tachyonic energy source in the dark and steered our structure toward it.
Harvest it and bring it back to recharge the battery. This is the last shift left: get ready to move out.
[PLACEHOLDER] The home AI's last message before the choice, a neutral test sentence.
